subject: MAP refresh: milestone resync and updated close velocity
messages:
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
To: Olivia Chen <olivia@skyward.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>
Date: Sat, 02 Oct 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: MAP draft + suggested milestones (post-call recap)

Hi Olivia —

Thanks again for the call this morning. Per our discussion I attached a working MAP draft (Skyward_MAP_draft_v2.xlsx) with the items we agreed to surface: core milestones, owners, dependencies, and a first-pass target close. High-level notes: 

- Target close in the draft: 2027-11-30 (subject to procurement timelines)
- Phase 1 priority: security review (SOC2 evidence) and network onboarding — Skyward procurement identified these as blockers
- Phase 2: pilot (2-week smoke) and performance tuning — Redwood-owned tasks listed

Action items for confirmation: 
1) Can you confirm the incumbent procurement review window (you mentioned week of 10/18)?
2) Please confirm the Skyward owner for reverse proxy / firewall exceptions (I listed "Procurement Team" pending a named contact)
3) Are there any internal signoff steps on your side we should add (legal, infosec playbook, finance)?

I've called out suggested owners in column C of the spreadsheet. If procurement pushes the review out we recommend staggering pilot milestones so the security onboarding is completed first and the pilot kickoff moves by two weeks.

Next steps: 
- If the procurement window holds, we keep the 11/30 close and schedule a MAP checkpoint next Thursday (10/07) to finalize procurement artifacts. 
- If procurement needs more time, I can publish a reprioritized milestone ordering by EOD Monday (10/04).

(attachment: Skyward_MAP_draft_v2.xlsx)

Thanks,
Ben
Ben Carter | Account Executive
Redwood Inference

Date: Mon, 04 Oct 2027 08:36:00 -0700
Subject: Re: MAP draft + suggested milestones (post-call recap)

Ben —

Thanks for the recap and the draft — helpful layout. Quick update from our side: procurement confirmed the earliest window for vendor security review is the week of 10/25, not 10/18 as I initially thought. That pushes our internal approval cadence by roughly two weeks.

Implications for the MAP: 
- We need to move the security evidence collection and procurement submission earlier this week so docs are ready by 10/20.
- Pilot kickoff will likely slip ~2 weeks; target close is more realistic around mid-December now (we're thinking 12/15).
- Legal doesn't require additional terms for this pilot, but procurement wants a high-level runbook for data handling and a SOC2 artifact list.

I've attached the procurement checklist (PDF) and copied procurement@skyward.ai to streamline any direct questions. Please update the MAP to reflect the new close target and reprioritized milestones.

Olivia Chen
Director, Product Innovation
Skyward AI
(attachment: Skyward_procurement_checklist.pdf)

Subject: Re: MAP draft + suggested milestones (post-call recap) — proposed reprioritization

Olivia / procurement team —

Appreciate the heads up. Per your timing I'm proposing a minimal MAP re-sequence so security evidence and the procurement submission are completed first. Attached is a one-page reprioritized milestone summary (I updated dates in the spreadsheet and included an action owner column). Key changes: 

- Deliverables moved earlier this week: evidence package (SOC2 matrix, access logs), network onboarding checklist — owner: Marissa Cole (CS)
- Procurement submission target: 2027-10-20 — owner: Olivia / procurement@skyward.ai (please confirm)
- Pilot kickoff adjusted to 2027-11-08 (2-week pilot window 11/08–11/22) — owner: Neha Kapoor (SE) for Redwood configuration tasks
- Target close updated to 2027-12-15 (reflects procurement and engineering buffer)

Requests for Skyward: 
- Olivia / procurement: please confirm the internal reviewer name for firewall exceptions so we can add them to the network checklist (I left a placeholder).
- If procurement needs a specific format for SOC2 artifacts, send over the template and Marissa will align the evidence list.

I'll post the updated MAP in HubSpot and share the Drive folder. If that sequencing looks good I'll schedule a MAP checkpoint for 10/07 to confirm artifacts and owners.

(attachment: Skyward_MAP_draft_v2.xlsx)

Thanks,
Ben

- Marissa here — I'll own the SOC2 artifacts and evidence list. I've attached the SOC2 evidence matrix we typically provide (SOC2_evidence_matrix_v1.pdf). I'll align formats with procurement if they have a template.
- Neha will coordinate the pilot configuration and a pre-pilot checklist for network/firewall settings.
- Procurement @ Skyward: Olivia — can you confirm the internal reviewer for firewall exceptions so Neha can set the exact IP ranges?

Next checkpoint: 10/07 at 10:00 AM PT for the MAP walkthrough (30 minutes) — invite sent to everyone in this thread.

Updated timeline summary (as Ben outlined): final target close 2027-12-15.
